budget_rule: Sum of per-task budgets must equal 120 MB exactly. This is the only cap on final submitted evidence; temporary/draft capture is not counted.
safety_first_step: Confirm the training board supply is isolated. Do not energise or work on a live circuit. Verify the circuit is de-energised using the approved tester before touching any conductor. Any energisation or powered test may only be performed by the authorised training-board supervisor.

tasks.title: Safety & PPE
tasks.evidence_hint: Photos of PPE worn; supply isolated; tester check before touching; short SD clip of the check.
step_guide: Confirm the training board supply is isolated. Do not energise or work on a live circuit. Verify the circuit is de-energised using the approved tester before touching any conductor. Any energisation or powered test may only be performed by the authorised training-board supervisor.
Put on required PPE for this task: head, eye/face, hand and foot protection.
Photograph yourself wearing full PPE.
Isolate the training board supply at the main switch/MCB and photograph the isolated switch.
Perform a dead-test with the voltage tester on the isolated circuit and record a short clip (10-20s) showing the tester reading zero/no-voltage before you touch any conductor.
Photograph the work area housekeeping (tools laid out, waste segregated, walkway clear).

tasks.title: Tools & meter use
tasks.evidence_hint: Tools laid out and named; multimeter continuity/voltage check; HD close-up photo of the display.
step_guide: Confirm the training board supply is isolated. Do not energise or work on a live circuit. Verify the circuit is de-energised using the approved tester before touching any conductor. Any energisation or powered test may only be performed by the authorised training-board supervisor.
Lay out the hand/power tools and measuring devices you will use (pliers, screwdrivers, wire stripper, multimeter, tong tester) and photograph them.
Perform a basic pre-use check on a power tool (cable, casing, switch) and record a short clip.
With the circuit isolated and confirmed dead by tester, use the multimeter to check continuity on the training-board circuit; photograph a HD close-up of the display showing the reading.
Measure and cut a short length of wire/conduit to a given dimension using the correct tool; photograph the measurement and the cut.
Clean and put away the tools; photograph the stored, maintained tool set.

tasks.title: LV wiring (switchboard)
tasks.evidence_hint: SD overview of wiring a switch + socket on the training board; HD close-ups of terminations; continuity test.
step_guide: Confirm the training board supply is isolated. Do not energise or work on a live circuit. Verify the circuit is de-energised using the approved tester before touching any conductor. Any energisation or powered test may only be performed by the authorised training-board supervisor.
Read the single-phase wiring diagram for the switch + socket circuit on the training board and photograph it alongside your marked-up conduit run.
Record an SD overview clip of laying/clamping conduit and pulling wire through to the switch and socket positions.
Terminate the switch and socket; photograph HD close-ups of each termination (tight, correct terminal, no exposed copper).
With the circuit still isolated, use the tester/multimeter to verify continuity and correct wiring; photograph the reading. Do not reconnect the supply yourself.
Assist with the earthing connection for the circuit and photograph the earth termination.

tasks.title: Temporary lighting / fault
tasks.evidence_hint: Set up a temporary lighting point; find and fix a planted loose connection; before/after photos, all with the circuit isolated.
step_guide: Confirm the training board supply is isolated. Do not energise or work on a live circuit. Verify the circuit is de-energised using the approved tester before touching any conductor. Any energisation or powered test may only be performed by the authorised training-board supervisor.
Check cable, conduit, lamp holder and fixtures against the manufacturer spec before starting; photograph the check.
With the circuit isolated, lay the cable to the lighting point and fix the light fitting securely; record an SD clip of the installation.
Terminate and tag the temporary line for supervisor inspection; photograph the tagged, secured connection.
Locate the planted loose connection/fault using the tester on the isolated circuit; photograph the fault 'before' state.

Repair the fault (re-terminate, replace the damaged part) and photograph the 'after' state plus a continuity check performed with the tester, circuit still isolated, confirming the fix. Any powered verification is performed only by the authorised training-board supervisor after your work is inspected.

tasks.title: Temporary LV panel
tasks.evidence_hint: Connect a small distribution board (MCB, earth, labelling) on the training board, circuit isolated throughout; overview + close-ups.
step_guide: Confirm the training board supply is isolated. Do not energise or work on a live circuit. Verify the circuit is de-energised using the approved tester before touching any conductor. Any energisation or powered test may only be performed by the authorised training-board supervisor.
Read the SLD for the small distribution board and photograph it next to the unassembled board.
With the circuit isolated, install the MCB(s), sockets and switches into the board per the SLD; record an SD overview clip of the assembly.
Terminate incoming and outgoing cables; photograph HD close-ups of each termination (tightness, correct terminal).
Connect and photograph the earthing of the panel.

Tag and barricade the board for supervisor inspection; photograph the tagged board and a final continuity/test-lamp check that you perform with the circuit still isolated. Do not energise the board yourself -- any powered test is performed only by the authorised training-board supervisor after inspecting your work.

not_task_evidenced_nos.note: CON/N8001 (teamwork), CON/N8002 (plan & organise) and DGT/VSQ/N0101 (employability skills) are compulsory NOS in the official QP but are not given dedicated capture tasks in the MVP. They are covered only by the worker's self-declaration (work setting / prior training, not scored -- see packs/ae-con-q0602/mapping/thresholds.json) plus up to 3 short assessor questions, recorded as assessor notes. This is a stated, open gap versus full QP coverage (master plan p.4) and is out of scope for the rubric/matcher in P1.
